body.focus: Fix ISSUE-b1c7c1bc57962e97: msgRow (render-registry.ts renderRegistryWebviewSource) collapses on isLong(raw) regardless of role, so long assistant (LLM) answers render as a 3-line preview. Make the ASSISTANT row exempt from default collapsing so it always renders in full; the user row keeps collapsing when long (deliberate narrowing, recorded in the ISSUE). Do NOT weaken host.collapsible — tool-command, tool-result and caption rows must keep their default-collapsed behaviour. Rewrite the vacuous ac3 test at render-registry.test.ts:472 so it renders a message isLong() actually classifies as long (>3 newlines or >240 chars) and asserts no collapse wrapper; add a companion assertion that a long TOOL row still collapses, so the carve-out cannot silently disable the affordance. Presentation-only: no markup, protocol, view-model or persistence change.
